Funds originated from business account ACC-10042 were routed through multiple intermediary accounts before being transmitted to offshore beneficiaries in Cyprus and UAE. External fraud database matches confirm association with a known 314(b) inquiry and a synthetic identity ring. Round-tripping of $47,000 within 72 hours and high transaction velocity (12 transfers in 48h vs. baseline of 2/month) further elevate risk. Previous SAR (SAR-2026-00147) filed for structuring. Customer remains high-risk with enhanced due diligence flag, though passport verification returned authentic. Ongoing activity warrants SAR filing and continued monitoring.
